name: Thekla
royal_plates_note: Genuine Coordinator image-generator Royal Plates installed per #560 (map.png 1600x1200, map.svg 1600x1200, image.png 1600x1000)

anti_trude_vector.medium: Kinetic Canvas2D perpetual timber-and-iron scaffolding elevation coupled with a solar-elevation armistice chronometer, nocturnal 1:1 starry blueprint plumb-line projector, and dual daytime carpenter-foley / nocturnal astral-chord WebAudio synthesizer

canonical_stones.label: Plank Fences at the Arrival Palisade
Billowing Sackcloth Screens Veiling Inner Bays
Wooden Catwalks Hanging from Hemp Ropes

inner_arch_invariants.perpetual_scaffolding_veil: Parting sackcloth screens never reveals a finished static city, only deeper tiers of scaffolding, armatures, and embracing beams.
inner_arch_invariants.anti_destruction_law: While daytime construction proceeds (isConstructing === true), destructionCannotBegin === true and destructionRate === 0. Prematurely halting work in daylight (forceStopDaytimeWork) sets destructionCannotBegin === false, loosening planks and raising destructionProgress (> 0) for both city and cosmos ('Not only the city') until work resumes.
inner_arch_invariants.sunset_armistice_and_starry_blueprint: At sunset (solarPhase === 'sunset' or 'night'), work stops naturally while keeping destructionRate === 0; at night (solarPhase === 'night'), blueprintRevealed === true and starry constellations project 1:1 geometric plumb-lines onto every crane, beam, catwalk, and trestle.

hard_gates.HG-1: Zero occurrences of forbidden external URL schemes, parent-path traversals, or SVG namespace attributes; zero runtime JS console or page errors; responsive 1280x800 and 390x844 layout without overflow.
hard_gates.HG-2: 100% bespoke hyphenated Thekla custom DOM elements and .thk-* CSS classes; zero generic layout/wrapper tags; Anti-Trude J_dom < 0.05.
hard_gates.HG-3: Interactive cranes hoisting cranes, sackcloth veil parting onto deeper scaffolding, halting daytime construction immediately starting destruction ('Not only the city') until resumed, and sunset/night armistice revealing 1:1 starry blueprint plumb-lines.
hard_gates.HG-4: thekla-plate-drawer [P] loads genuine Royal Plates map.png (1600x1200) and image.png (1600x1000) with complete === true, [Z] loupe toggle, Escape close, and intact map.svg on disk.
